utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Could we have appearances for the day starting with Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you, Your Honour. Mark Harmon, Salvatore Cannata, and Inger de Ru, for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everybody in the courtroom. Mr. Perisic is today represented by Daniela Tasic, Tina Drolec, Milos Androvic, and we have Eric Tully, our intern, Mr. Gregor Guy-Smith, and myself, Novak Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Lukic. May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Harmon, this is the end of the third day. At the beginning, you said you may take two or three days. How much longer are you going to be, sir?

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: I should be finished tomorrow, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Are you likely to take the entire session tomorrow, the entire day?

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: I'll take at least a session, Your Honour. It's possible I'll take the entire day. Yes, sir.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: It's possible that you will take the entire day.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay. Then the matter stands adjourned to tomorrow morning at 9.00. Courtroom II, court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 23rd day of July, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.04 p.m.
